passage: To create the sculptures in his 2018 exhibition Echoes of Memory, artist Greg Dalton used a technique called material sampling. This method often involves selecting fragments from historical artworks and then incorporating each piece as a central element in a new sculptural composition. Dalton wanted the sculptures in Echoes of Memory to pay tribute to influential Latino artists of the past, so he chose fragments from works by artists such as Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo. Working in this way can be technically demanding and might seem as though it would produce disjointed sculptures. However, critics praised Echoes of Memory as an elegant and moving homage to the artists who inspired it. This reaction suggests that ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: Dalton successfully used the material sampling technique to achieve his goal for Echoes of Memory.
choices.B: most critics didn't understand Dalton's goal for Echoes of Memory.
choices.C: Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo are two of Rivera's most admired artists.
choices.D: Dalton inspired many other artists to create sculptures using the material sampling technique.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of Greg Dalton's sculpture exhibition Echoes of Memory. The text explains that Dalton used a technique called material sampling to create the sculptures in his exhibition. According to the text, the method involves basing a new sculpture on fragments from existing artworks. The text then mentions Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo as examples of influential Latino artists whose work fragments form the basis of Dalton's sculptures. The text goes on to say that this technique is demanding and that the resulting sculptures can be disjointed, but critics have positively reviewed Dalton's exhibition. If the critics of Echoes of Memory specifically note that the work is an "elegant and moving homage to the artists who inspired it," then they must have appreciated how Dalton used the material sampling technique to pay tribute to other artists. This suggests that Dalton was successful in using the material sampling technique to achieve his goal of honoring Latino artists in his exhibition.
